messages:
marta_cs: FYI we just got an escalation from BrightDeliver — their rerank/grounding quality tanked right after yesterday's v2 rollout. They say top citations are unrelated and recall for older docs dropped a lot.

sam_eng: Thanks, can you paste a minimal request and the model/version they hit?

marta_cs: Customer example: `POST /v1/rerank` body: { model: "rdw-rerank-v2", query: "refund policy for delayed shipments", candidates: [...ids] } — they say scores used to surface doc A but now rank doc C and D instead.

eli_ml: Do they include embedding vectors or just IDs? Could be an embedding mismatch or index refresh.

marta_cs: They send candidate IDs (we look up vectors server-side). They reported this started at ~14:12 UTC when we completed the rollout to hosted.

devon_infra: Deploy-bot shows `deploy rdw-rerank-v2` completed at 14:09 UTC with canary -> global flip. No infra errors in CI.

sam_eng: Can we get request/response logs (traces) and reranker scores? Need to see pre- and post-score distributions.

marta_cs: Attached the customer's anonymized example in thread (they redacted user ids). Basic response snippet: ```json
{ "query": "refund policy for delayed shipments", "top_k": 5, "results": [ {"id": "docC", "score": 0.92 }, {"id": "docA", "score": 0.61 } ] }
```

eli_ml: Hmm scores look high but ordering changed. What does the raw retrieval step return before rerank? If retrieval lost relevant candidates, reranker can't fix it.

marta_cs: Customer attached retrieval debug: `retrieval_candidates: [docC, docD, docX, docA]` — previously it was `[docA, docB, docC]`.

sam_eng: That suggests retrieval recall dropped. Check: did the embedding model or index config change alongside rerank rollout? Sometimes we roll model pairs in same release.

devon_infra: Looking at release notes, we changed the default embedding quantization profile for memory optimizations in the same deploy (embedding-quant=hf-q8_0). Could that affect nearest neighbor similarity scores?

eli_ml: Yes — quantization + new index sharding can change neighbor ordering if vector norms shift. Also check whether we normalized vectors before indexing. If normalization was accidentally toggled off, dot-product vs cosine mismatch can reorder results.

ryan_product: We did enable a new cost-saving quant profile flagged for non-critical workloads, but this customer is on paid tier — they should be excluded. Maybe a routing policy bug applied the new profile globally.

sam_eng: Can we repro by fetching embeddings for a few customer docs with both old and new quant profiles and measuring cosine similarity to the query embedding?

devon_infra: I'll run a quick job to compute pairwise similarities against local snapshots. If a normalization flag flipped, differences will be obvious.

deploy-bot: compliance-check: rollout v2 flagged embedding-quant-change true, route policy: hosted-default.

marta_cs: Customer requests a rollback if we can't fix quickly — they're seeing production traffic impact.

sam_eng: Short-term: can we patch routing to force this customer's workspace to use previous embedding profile and reranker stack? That should restore previous results while we root-cause.

devon_infra: I can add a route override for workspace brightdeliver to use embedding profile `hf-q4` and reranker `rdw-rerank-v1` by ID. Will need a quick approve.

eli_ml: Meanwhile I'll compare reranker score deltas and retrieval nearest neighbor lists for a sample of 200 queries. If the retrieval candidate set differs, blame is on embedding/index. If candidate set is same but reranker scores flip, then reranker model likely regressed.

sam_eng: Good plan. Marta — can you get 3 reproducible queries from the customer with the exact time + request id? That speeds log lookup.

marta_cs: Sent 3 examples and request ids to this thread. Also noted they observed missing citations (some doc metadata keys empty).

devon_infra: Found a backlog in the indexer job during the deploy window — some index shards didn't finish compaction; fallback shards served partial indexes for ~8 minutes. That can cause recall drops.

eli_ml: Partial indexes explain missing older docs. Combine that with quant change and you get bigger shifts.

ryan_product: If indexer backlog is root cause, customer-facing remediation should include rollback of model changes + reindex and a postmortem + SLA credit offer. We should be proactive.

sam_eng: Agreed. For immediate mitigation: 1) route brightdeliver to safe config, 2) requeue compaction job with high priority, 3) re-run reranker evaluation on repro set and confirm metrics.

devon_infra: Route override in place for brightdeliver. Reindex compaction started (priority=high). ETA ~12 minutes.

deploy-bot: route-override applied: workspace=brightdeliver, embedding_profile=hf-q4, reranker_model=rdw-rerank-v1 by devon_infra @ 14:27 UTC.

marta_cs: Customer confirmed a partial improvement after route override — they report citations more relevant but still occasional misses.

eli_ml: We'll finish the analysis. If reindex + config restore fully fixes repro set, we'll schedule permanent rollback for non-targeted customers and tighten rollout gating on index/backlog checks.

sam_eng: Thanks all. Please add short notes to the incident log and I'll start the post-incident RCA draft.

marta_cs: Adding notes and tagging account team. BrightDeliver wants an ETA on permanent fix.

ryan_product: I'll prepare a customer update: apology, what happened, actions taken, ETA for full reindex and verification (end of day).

marta_cs: Thanks — will follow up with customer now. (thumbsup)
